title: The "goes against your ruling" widening label fires on a global allow entry in claude-settings itself
why: It steered triage and the consultant to the wrong pick on the reinstall allow entry.
source: Consultant 20:20 CST Nov 13, from the owner's chat 20:16 ("My sessions shudda known better the right answer is obviously a"); triage did not see the chat.
note: Filed 20:17 CST Nov 13. The label "Goes against your ruling: a repo changes to fit a shared tool, never the tool to fit a repo" (hooks/question_form.py, skill waiting-page, decisions question-form and port-keeps-behaviour) was meant only for a per-repo exception that bends a shared tool. It fired on a global allow entry in claude-settings itself, where the shared tool is what is being changed. Fix: the label and the widens flag apply only when a change is for one repo against a shared tool; a change to claude-settings' own shared settings does not widen. The lane reads the check and the texts first. A check change: test-author red case first, builder, reviewer. Needs a lane.
